about: Moses has the twelve rods written with the names of their fathers' houses and laid up before God overnight, and Aaron's rod is found blossoming and fragrant (Numbers 17). The chronicler reads the rod as Mary and the ark, gold, wood, gomor, manna and tablets as figures of her and of Christ, then the rock Moses struck at Kadesh (Numbers 20) as Christ, with a chain of Gospel sayings.

sentences.i: And God said to him: Lay them (?) toward Zion, to the tent of meeting (?), and shut them in there until dawn; then take them in their presence and give them out, to each one his rod, to each of the houses of their fathers, to each their names, that which is written on his rod. And the man in whose rod a sign is found, he is the one I have chosen to be my priest.
sentences.n: ወይቤሎ 'and he said to him' (ይቤ + -ሎ 'to him'). Imperatives: ውግር 'lay, cast' (?), ወዕጸው 'and shut in', ወንሥኦን 'and take them' (ንሥእ-, the form of ንሣእ before a suffix, + -ኦን '3fp them'), ወሀቦሙ 'and give them'. ኀበ 'toward, to'. ዘመርጡል: ዘ is the relative 'of, which', but መርጡል is not a word I can read and may be a corrupt or foreign name (?); I leave it as märṭul in `l`. Ch. 17–20 takes it as an epithet of the tent (perhaps 'meeting'), so `i` reads 'tent of meeting (?)'. ለለ is distributive 'to each'. ዘጽሑፍ 'that which is written' (passive participle of ጸሐፈ). ወዘተረክበ 'and he in whose [rod] was found' (ተረክበ, passive of ረከበ). ይኩነኒ ካህነ 'may he be to me a priest' (ይኩን 'let be' + -ኒ 'to me'; ካህነ accusative). Compare Numbers 17:5.

sentences.i: In the heavens too she is pure, and moves about with the angels. And that rod of Aaron is present in Zion, with a gomor full of manna and with the two tablets that were written by the fingers of God. And heavenly, spiritual Zion is above them: Zion, whose making and colour are wondrous, whose maker and fashioner is he himself, for the dwelling of his glory.
sentences.n: ታንሶሱ 'she walks about' (3fs imperfect of the quadriliteral አንሶሰወ, as in the published entry). ህሉት ይእቲ 'she is present' (ህሉት is the feminine of the adjective ህልው 'existing'). ጎሞር መና ምልእት 'a gomor of manna, full' (Exodus 16:33; the gomor and the rod are laid up in the ark, Hebrews 9:4); ክልኤ ጽላት 'two tablets'; በአጽባዕተ 'by the fingers of' (Exodus 31:18). ጽዮን ሰማያዊት 'Zion, heavenly' (adjective after its noun). Zion is both the ark and the heavenly dwelling. መልዕልቴሆሙ 'above them'. እንተ ግብራ ወኅብራ ነኪር 'whose making and colour are wondrous' (እንተ is a feminine relative, with -ሃ '3fs her', written -ራ, on each noun). ለሊሁ 'he himself'; ኬንያሃ 'her fashioner' (as in ch. 1). ለማኅደረ 'for the dwelling of' (ለ- with a construct). The unit ends at the section mark ፨.

sentences.i: As for the gold, it is the purity of the Godhead that came down from the heavens, for the Godhead holds all the heavens and the earth. And so the ark, the dwelling of heavenly Zion, was overlaid with gold. The ark is interpreted as Mary, and the wood that does not rot is interpreted as Christ our Savior. The gomor, which is the golden basket within the ark, is interpreted as Mary; and the manna in the basket is interpreted as the flesh of Christ, who (?) came down from the heavens. The word of God written on the two tablets is interpreted as Christ, the Son of God; and spiritual Zion is interpreted as the light of the Godhead;
sentences.n: The interpretation begins; it runs without a ፤ for 60 words and is left whole. ወርቅሰ 'and gold, indeed' (-ሰ marks the topic). መለኮት 'Godhead, divinity'; ጽርየተ 'purity of' (construct). ይእኅዝ 'holds' (3ms imperfect, አኀዘ). ተለብጠት 'was overlaid' (3fs passive). ማኅደራ ለጽዮን 'the dwelling of Zion' (a noun with -ሃ '3fs her', written -ራ, and ለ- marking the owner, a common way to express 'of'). ትተረጐም 'is interpreted' (3fs) and ይተረጐም (3ms): the ተ- passive of ተርጐመ 'interpret, translate'; the subject is the thing read, the meaning follows without a preposition. መሶበ ወርቅ 'a basket of gold' (construct). ሥጋሁ ለክርስቶስ 'the flesh of Christ'. ወልደ 'son of' (construct). ዘወረደ 'who came down' (ወረደ, 3ms perfect with the masculine relative ዘ-). First occurrence: ዘ agrees with masculine መለኮት 'Godhead'. Second occurrence (after ሥጋሁ ለክርስቶስ): the antecedent is undecidable, Christ ('who came down') or his flesh or the manna ('which came down'; cf. John 6:51), because ዘ is masculine and fits all three; `i` reads 'who' and marks it (?).

sentences.n: Here the figure of the pearl is interpreted. ወላዲተ ብርሃን 'mother of light' (lit. 'bearer of'; construct). ዘእምኔሃ ተሠገወ 'from whom became flesh' (ተሠገወ, the usual verb for the incarnation). ዘእምኔሃ ተሠገወ: ዘ is masculine, so it refers to ብርሃን 'light', not to Mary. ወባሕርይ ዘአጥረያ 'and the pearl, he who acquired it' is elliptical (?). አክራጦስ (Akraṭos) looks like a Greek name or title (perhaps 'unmixed') (?). ዘአልቦቱ 'who has not' (አልቦ 'there is not' + -ቱ 'to him'); ቱስሕት 'fault, error' (?).

sentences.i: And God said to him: Take your rod and strike that rock (?). And Moses struck it, along its length and its breadth, in the likeness of the sign of the cross; and water flowed in twelve rivers, and they drank from it, and their people and their cattle were sated; and after their drinking, that rock followed them. The rock is interpreted as Christ, the rivers as the apostles, what they drank as the teaching of the apostles, and the rod too as the wood of the cross;
sentences.n: Numbers 20:7-11, with the tradition of the rock that followed (1 Corinthians 10:4). ንሣእ 'take' (imperative); ዝብጣ 'strike it' (imperative ዝብጥ + -ሃ '3fs it', merging into -ጣ); እዝኅ is a word I cannot place and the sentence reads on without it (?); `i` supplies 'rock' from the context (Numbers 20:8) (?). ኑኃ ወግድማ 'its length and its breadth' (? ግድም 'width, side'). በአርአያ 'in the likeness of' (construct). ወውሕዘት 'and it flowed' (3fs); ፲ወ፪ 'twelve' (10 and 2). ወሰትዩ 'and they drank'; ወረወዩ I read as 'and were sated' (ረወየ), printed as two words (?). ሰቲዮሙ 'their drinking' (verbal noun + -ሙ). ተለወቶሙ 'it followed them'. ይተረጐም 'is interpreted' as above, here with በ-: በክርስቶስ 'in/of Christ' (?). ወበትርኒ 'and the rod too' (-ኒ); ዕፀ 'wood of' (construct).

glossary.አምላክ: አምላክ — God, god (noun, singular; here 'a God') · 'god' in ዘእምአምላክ 'that is from god' (no article)

glossary.አስማቲሆሙ: ስም — their names (noun, plural አስማት + -ሆሙ '3mp their')

glossary.አውፅኦሙ: አውፅአ — he brought them out (3ms perfect, causative አ- stem, w-ṣ-ʾ, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.አዕጹቂሁ: ዕፅ — its branches (plural አዕጹቅ + -ሁ '3ms its'; lemma ዕፅ taken from the sense) (?)

glossary.አዶንያስ: አዶንያስ — Adonyas (proper name, given as the owner of a tribal rod; identification uncertain) (?)
glossary.ኢትትረከብ: ተረክበ — is not found (ኢ- + 3fs imperfect, passive tG of ረከበ)
glossary.ኢይትሀወክ: ተሀውከ — he is not shaken (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, tG of ሀወከ 'disturb, shake')
glossary.ኣርኢ: አርአየ — I show, let me show (1sg subjunctive/jussive, causative of ርእየ)
glossary.እምሥጋሃ: ሥጋ — from her flesh (እም- + ሥጋ + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.እምሰማያት: ሰማይ — from the heavens (እም- + plural ሰማያት)
glossary.እምቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, prior to · 'from before' (እምቅድመ ገጾሙ 'from before their faces')
glossary.እምኅሊና: ኅሊና — from, beyond the thought (እም- + noun)
glossary.እምአጋንንት: ጋኔን — by, from demons (እም- + plural አጋንንት)

glossary.እምከናፍሪሃ: ከንፈር — from her lips (እም- + plural ከናፍር + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.እምኵሉ: ኵሉ — out of all, from all (እም- 'from' + ኵሉ) · more than all (እምኵሉ with አፍቀረተኪ 'she loved you more than all')
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took')

glossary.እዝኅ: እዝኅ — a word not identified, apparently qualifying 'that rock' (?) (possibly corrupt) (?)
glossary.እዴሁ: እድ — his hand (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; with suffix እዴ-)

glossary.ካህነ: ካህን — priest (noun, accusative, predicate after ይኩንከ)
glossary.ክልኤ: ክልኤቱ — two (numeral; the short form ክልኤ before a noun)
glossary.ኵለንታሁ: ኵለንታ — all of him, his whole self (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'

glossary.ወላዕሌከ: ላዕል — and upon you (ወ- + ላዕል 'above, upon' with suffix -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ወላዲተ: ወላዲት — bearer of, mother of (noun, fem., construct; active participle of ወለደ; ወላዲተ አምላክ 'Mother of God')
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')

glossary.ወሖረ: ሖረ — and he went (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወመትልው: መትልው — and follower (?) (ወ- + noun, from ተልወ 'follow'; here perhaps adverbial 'next') (?)
glossary.ወማኅበረ: ማኅበር — and assembly of (ወ- + noun, construct)

glossary.ወርኵስ: ርኵስ — and uncleanness, impurity (ወ- + noun/adjective ርኩስ 'unclean')
glossary.ወሰቲዮሙ: ሰትየ — and their drinking (ወ- + verbal noun ሰቲ + -ዮሙ '3mp their') (?)

glossary.ወሰገዲ: ሰገደ — and they bowed down (ወ- + 3mp perfect, spelled ሰገዲ for ሰገዱ) (?)

glossary.ወበሰማያትኒ: ሰማይ — and in the heavens also (ወ- + በ- + plural ሰማያት + enclitic -ኒ)

glossary.ወባሕርይ: ባሕርይ — and pearl (ወ- + noun; ባሕርይ 'pearl'; elsewhere 'nature')
glossary.ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)

glossary.ወተቀነዩ: ተቀነየ — and serve! (ወ- + 2mp imperative, tG of ቀነየ; takes ለ- 'to')
glossary.ወተወልደ: ተወልደ — and was born (ወ- + 3m sg passive perfect)
glossary.ወተገምረ: ተገምረ — and he was enclosed, wrapped (ወ- + 3ms perfect, passive of ገምረ) (?)

glossary.ወንጽሐ: ንጽሕ — and purity of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወአልዐሎን: አልዐለ — and he lifted them (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦን '3fp them'; the stem and root are not confirmed without Dillmann) (?)
glossary.ወአሕሩጊሁ: ሐረግ — and its shoots, tendrils (ወ- + plural of ሐረግ + -ሁ '3ms its'; plural form uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወአምጽኡ: አምጽአ — and they brought (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of መጽአ) · and bring! (ወ- + 2mp imperative)
glossary.ወአምጽኦን: አምጽአ — and he brought them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of መጽአ, + -ኦን '3fp them')
glossary.ወአናቅጺሃ: አንቀጽ — and her gates (ወ- + plural አናቅጽ + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ወአንጐርጐሩ: አንጐርጐረ — and they murmured (ወ- + 3mp perfect, quadriliteral)
glossary.ወአይድዖ: አይድዐ — and he told him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʾa-stem, + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወኢተገብረ: ተገብረ — and was not made (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms perfect, passive tG of ገብረ)
glossary.ወእንስሳሆሙ: እንስሳ — and their animals, cattle (ወ- + noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወእንተ: እንተ — and she who, which (ወ- + fem. relative)
glossary.ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
glossary.ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
glossary.ወኰኵሕሰ: ኰኵሕ — and the rock, indeed (ወ- + noun + -ሰ 'indeed, as for')
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወውሕዘት: ወሐዘ — and it flowed (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, w-ḥ-z)
glossary.ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወዕጸው: ዐጸወ — and shut! (ወ- + imperative 2ms, G, ʿ-ṣ-w)
glossary.ወዘሰትዩ: ሰትየ — and what they drank (ወ- + ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect)
glossary.ወዘበጣ: ዘበጠ — and he struck it (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ሃ '3fs it')
glossary.ወዘተረክበ: ተረክበ — and that which was found (ወ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive of ረከበ)
glossary.ወዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — and without (ወ- + preposition) · 'and before' + subjunctive (ወዘእንበለ ታጥብዎ 'and before she could nurse him')

glossary.ወዝብጣ: ዘበጠ — and strike it! (ወ- + 2ms imperative ዝብጥ + -ሃ '3fs it')
glossary.ወዩ: ረወየ — second part of the same split spelling, 'were sated' (?) (3mp perfect of ረወየ; word division uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወያገምራ: አገምረ — and he wraps, encloses her (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ገምረ, + -ሃ '3fs her') (?)
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይእኅዛ: አኀዘ — and he holds her (ወ- + 3ms imperfect + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ወይኩነኒ: ኮነ — and may he be to me (ወ- + 3ms jussive ይኩን + -ኒ 'to me')
glossary.ወይፀብጣ: ፀብጠ — and he weighs, handles her (?) (ወ- + 3ms imperfect + -ሃ '3fs her'; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወገብሩ: ገብረ — and they made, amounted to (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-r) · also 'and they did' (ወገብሩ ለነ ዘበሕጉ 'and they did for us what is by his law')
glossary.ወግድማ: ግድም — and her breadth (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun, sense uncertain + -ሃ '3fs her') (?)
glossary.ወጎሞር: ጎሞር — and gomor, the omer measure (ወ- + noun)
glossary.ወጽጌ: ጽጌ — and blossom of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወ፪: ፪ — and 2, spoken ወክልኤቱ (wä-kəlʾetu) 'and two' (ወ- 'and' + numeral); after ፲ it is spoken ዐሠርቱ ወክልኤቱ (ʿäśärtu wä-kəlʾetu) 'twelve'
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ውግር: ወገረ — throw, cast, place (?) (2ms imperative, G, w-g-r; sense in 'go to Zion' context uncertain)
glossary.ዐጸደ: ዐጸድ — enclosure, pen, courtyard (noun; construct 'pen of') · ዐጸደ ወይን 'vineyard' (lit. 'enclosure of wine'; ጒንደ ዐጸደ ወይን 'trunk of the vineyard', ch. 98)
glossary.ዕንቈ: ዕንቍ — jewel, precious stone (noun, construct 'stones of'; ዕንቈ ባሕርያተ 'pearl-stones')
glossary.ዕዲት: ዐደወ — surpassing, passing beyond (?) (feminine participle/adjective ዕዲት of ዐደወ; form uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘመርጡል: መርጡል — uncertain, unidentified; an epithet of the tent, perhaps 'meeting', as taken in ch. 17–20 (ዘ- 'of, which' + መርጡል, qualifying ደብተራ 'tent') (?)
glossary.ዘሠረጸት: ሠረጸ — which sprouted, budded (ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect, G, ś-r-ṣ)
glossary.ዘሣረረ: ሠረረ — who is founded, rooted (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G; spelled with ሣ; root not confirmed without Dillmann, cf. ch. 17–20, 35, 89) (?)
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘብዙኅ: ብዙኅ — of great, much (ዘ- + adjective ብዙኅ 'many, much'; ዘብዙኅ ሤጣ 'whose price is great')
glossary.ዘተወልደ: ተወልደ — who was born (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive/reflexive stem of ወለደ)
glossary.ዘተጽሕፈ: ተጽሕፈ — which was written (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, ተ- passive of ጸሐፈ)
glossary.ዘኀረየ: ኀረየ — who chose (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, ḫ-r-y)
glossary.ዘአልቦቱ: አልቦ — who has not (ዘ- + አልቦ 'there is not' + -ቱ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘአጥረያ: አጥረየ — who acquired her (ዘ- + 3ms perfect + -ሃ '3fs her'; sense of the verb uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘኢይነቅዝ: ነቀዘ — which does not rot (ዘ- relative + ኢ- negative + 3ms imperfect, n-q-z 'be worm-eaten, decay')
glossary.ዘእምብርሃን: ብርሃን — that (is) from light (ዘ- 'that which' + እም- 'from' + noun ብርሃን 'light')
glossary.ዘእምኔሃ: እም — which from her, who from her (ዘ- masculine relative, agreeing with ብርሃን 'light', + እምኔሃ 'from her')
glossary.ዘእምአምላክ: አምላክ — that (is) from god (ዘ- 'that which' + እም- 'from' + noun አምላክ 'god')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘወረደ: ወረደ — which came down (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ዘይወፅእ: ወጽአ — who comes out (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ዘይውሕዝ: ወሐዘ — which flows (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, w-ḥ-z)
glossary.ዘጽሑፍ: ጽሑፍ — what is written (ዘ- relative + passive participle ጽሑፍ)
glossary.ያበድሮን: አበደረ — he prefers (?) (3ms imperfect + -ኦን '3fp them', anticipating ለአናቅጸ; the root and sense are not confirmed without Dillmann) (?)
glossary.ይቤሎ: ብህለ — he said to him (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — he said to them (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይተረጐም: ተርጐመ — it is interpreted (3ms imperfect ይተረጐም, passive/reflexive ተ-stem)
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይእኅዝ: አኀዘ — he holds, grasps, contains (3ms imperfect, G, ʾ-ḫ-z)
glossary.ይኩነኒ: ኮነ — may he be to me (3ms jussive ይኩን + -ኒ 'to me')
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ዴዴ: ዴዴ — a word not identified, apparently a title or epithet of Christ after አነ 'I' (?) (possibly corrupt) (?)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ጎሞር: ጎሞር — gomor, omer (Hebrew loan; a measure, here the golden urn of manna)
glossary.ጸምኡ: ጸምአ — they thirsted (3mp perfect, G, ṣ-m-ʾ)
glossary.ጸቃውዕ: ጸቃውዕ — honeycomb (?) (noun; as in ch. 21–22; the sense is taken from the context, not confirmed) (?)
glossary.ጸብሐ: ጸብሐ — it dawned, became morning (3ms perfect, G, ṣ-b-ḥ)
glossary.ጽሩይ: ጽሩይ — pure, refined (adjective, passive participle of ጸረየ)
glossary.፺፰: ፺፰ — 98, spoken ተስዓ ወሰመንቱ (täsʿa wä-sämäntu) 'ninety-eight'; chapter number (numeral)
